text: ÖBAG, the Austrian state holding company managing the investments of the Republic of Austria, holds 31.5% of OMV.

source.name: OMV: Shareholder structure (omv.com)
source.quote: ÖBAG (Österreichische Beteiligungs AG) is the Austrian state-owned holding company managing the investments of the Republic of Austria.
source.note: Footnote 1 of OMV's shareholder-structure page; the same page lists ÖBAG's stake at 31.5%. Date is the day the page was opened.

additionalSources.name: ADNOC press release: ADNOC Closes Acquisition of 24.9% Stake in OMV
additionalSources.quote: Österreichische Beteiligungs AG (ÖBAG), an Austrian independent holding company, holds 31.5%
additionalSources.note: ADNOC's announcement of the completion of its purchase of 24.9% of OMV, describing the remaining shareholder structure.
